framed_pitch:
I'm putting this in front of you: I'm building Thuto.io , Thuto.io is an innovative South African EdTech platform designed to boost high school student motivation by transforming study efforts into actual financial rewards . how would you feel about paying a 50rand per month subscription for Thuto ?
I want your honest reaction — what works, what doesn't, what would put you off.
